lines.zh: 咕噜咕噜，爬行缓慢，步履沉重。
lines.en: Rum rum, moves slowly with heavy steps.

lines.zh: 啃咬竹叶，发出吱吱声响。
lines.en: Chews on bamboo leaves, makes a squeaking sound.

lines.zh: 好奇地探索四周，发出低吼。
lines.en: Curiously explores around, lets out a low growl.
Chews tree bark, makes a rustling sound.

lines.zh: 用双手轻拍地面，发出响声。
lines.en: Taps the ground gently with hands, makes a sound.

lines.zh: 用大手抓取竹子，发出咔嚓声。
lines.en: Grasps bamboo with big hands, makes a crackling sound.
Chews on fruit, makes a chewing sound.

lines.zh: 在草丛中缓慢前行，发出窸窸窣窣声。
lines.en: Moves slowly through the grass, makes rustling sounds.

lines.zh: 用脚掌轻踏地面，发出轻微声响。
lines.en: Taps the ground lightly with feet, makes a soft sound.

lines.zh: 用手指拨弄竹枝，发出沙沙声。
lines.en: Runs fingers through bamboo branches, makes a rustling sound
The smell of Zuloagae leads me on.

lines.zh: 我抓一把叶子边走边嚼。
lines.en: I grab a handful of leaves and chew as I go.
A few blades of grass cling to my fur.

lines.zh: 我学大人的样子晃晃身子。
lines.en: I sway my body the way the adults do.
The trail is narrow. I walk sideways.
I'm looking for the next bamboo stand.
My foot snaps a dry twig.

lines.zh: 用手指轻抚竹叶，显得悠闲。
lines.en: Gently strokes bamboo leaves, appears relaxed.
Gently shakes branches with big hands.

lines.zh: 闭目养神，偶尔发出呢喃。
用大嘴咀嚼竹茎，发出咔嚓声。
lines.en: Chews bamboo stems, makes a cracking sound.

lines.zh: 用双手捧着竹笋，显得好奇。
lines.en: Holds bamboo shoots with hands, looks curious.

lines.zh: 懒洋洋地躺下，目光游离。

lines.en: Gently stirs fallen leaves with fingers.

lines.zh: 用大手轻抚自己的毛发。
lines.en: Gently strokes its fur with big hands
I sit in the bamboo, spacing out.
Sees player, lets out a low growl.

lines.zh: 用大手抚摸玩家，显得友善。
向玩家发出邀请，低吼回应。
lines.en: Invites player with a low growl.

lines.zh: 用手指指向玩家，显得好奇。
lines.en: Points at player with finger, looks curious.
Approaches player, makes a soft hum.
Smiles at player, showing big teeth.

lines.zh: 用手指轻轻触碰玩家，显得友好。
盯着玩家手中的食物，发出叫声。
lines.en: Stares at player's food, makes a sound.

lines.zh: 向玩家发出邀请，轻哼回应。
lines.en: Invites player with a soft hum.

lines.zh: 幼猿抱着古竹，缩成一团。
lines.en: The young ape hugs the ancient bamboo and curls up.
I haven't grown big enough to stand.

lines.zh: 我还小，只会抱着竹子啃。
lines.en: I'm small — I only know how to gnaw bamboo.

lines.zh: 看着你，我心情都变好了。
lines.en: Just looking at you, it brightens my mood.
Have some fresh bamboo, it’s delicious.

lines.zh: 古竹 Zuloagae 非常美味哦。

lines.en: I've found something new, come see.
These exotic fruits are great too.

lines.zh: 一起做些有趣的事情吧。
你看起来很健康，我们可以交易。
lines.en: You look healthy, we can trade.

lines.zh: 竹林里那根嫩芽是我的。
lines.en: That young shoot in the bamboo is mine.

lines.zh: 退后一步，否则我会生气。
lines.en: Back off, or I'll get mad.

lines.zh: 我这么大个，走路会碰到你。
lines.en: Being this big, I bump into you when I walk.
Push me once and I swat back.

lines.zh: 我只攻击威胁我的东西。
我只是一个孩子，别害怕。
lines.en: I'm just a child, don't be afraid.
I won't attack you, I'm shy.

lines.zh: 找个合适的伴侣很重要。

lines.en: I need to find my mate.
Finding a partner is always good.
We need to take care of each other.

lines.zh: 软软的身体在手中蠕动！
lines.en: The soft body wriggles in your hand!

lines.zh: 我还没长成，只够抓你的裤脚。
lines.en: I'm not grown; your trouser leg is all I can grab.

lines.zh: 这根古竹，能换点水果吗？
lines.en: Could this ancient bamboo trade for some fruit?
It wriggles softly on its back

lines.zh: 它似乎对食物很感兴趣

lines.en: Searching for food in the tree hollow

lines.zh: 它对周围的环境很敏感
lines.en: It is sensitive to its surroundings
It's hiding behind the tree trunk
Found it deep in the cave
It seems to be watching me

lines.zh: 它在阳光下悠闲地爬行
lines.en: It's leisurely climbing in the sunlight
It's searching for food in the dirt

lines.zh: 它在远处发出微弱的声音
lines.en: It's making a faint sound in the distance
It notices me and starts moving

lines.zh: 树上有响声，我去瞧一眼。
lines.en: Something rustles in the trees; I'll take a look.

lines.zh: 它盯着我，我感觉很不舒服
lines.en: It stares at me, making me uncomfortable
It wants to communicate with me
It wants to get closer to me

lines.zh: 它对周围的环境保持警惕
lines.en: It remains vigilant of its surroundings
I roll out of the cultivator.

lines.zh: 毛还没长齐，眼睛倒睁开了。
lines.en: My fur is thin, but my eyes are open.
I smell the fresh scent of Zuloagae.
This magic stings worse than bamboo.
